expected.review_method: Independent original C1 source-row review; headline ledger entered separately from normalizePDF. First answer cell belongs to the named subgroup; farther numeric cells are explicit overall/subtotals, never extra students.
expected.review_scope: C1 applicants, admitted, enrolled, every printed gender/status group, and available residency columns reviewed. Other source-extracted metrics are preserved with evidence but are not all manually verified.
notes: C10 publishes counts 466/682/264/19/2 beside disjoint rank-band annotations Top10%,11–25%,26–50%,51–75%,76–Bottom. These are counts and category labels, not cumulative class-rank percentages. Top10/top25/top50 percentage metrics remain missing; original figures are retained.
